FN-NYNFT8J-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 128
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator Tim Melson
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 128 as introduced would abolish the State Board of Health and would confer all
duties and authorities provided by law to the State Committee of Public Health. This bill will
not otherwise affect state or local funding.
